Newsletter Name Generator

Name your newsletter in seconds — enter your niche and choose classic, modern, playful, or premium naming styles.

📖 How to use

  1. Type your newsletter niche.
  2. Pick a naming style.
  3. Press Generate, then click any name to copy it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What naming styles are there?

Classic (The X Times), modern (X Brief), playful (The Daily X), and premium (The X Review) — each with its own format bank.

How do I use my niche?

Type your niche (e.g. “AI”) and every name is built around it.

How do I copy a name?

Click any name or its Copy button to copy it instantly.
